methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The valuation universe consists of 8 private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity, alongside 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The robotics and manufacturing sector yielded 8 total peers, but applying stage-specificity filters—same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar valuation tier—produced insufficient datapoints to support a reliable median calculation. The analysis identified zero same-stage comparable transactions and only one adjacent-stage peer, falling short of the three-datapoint minimum required for statistical validity. Using an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable bias given the substantial heterogeneity in business models, capital efficiency, and market position across the broader peer group.

Without sufficient narrow comparables, triangulation via peer-median is not supported by the available data. Valuation analysis would require alternative methods—such as venture capital method, revenue multiple analysis on the broader peer set (if revenue data exists), or cost-to-duplicate approaches—to establish a defensible range. The primary uncertainty remains the sparsity of directly analogous pre-seed stage transactions in this sector, which limits the precision of any market-derived valuation.
